messages:
deploy-bot: :rocket: Scheduled deploy: release v1.8.3 -> prod in 30m. Change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Initiator: @alice. Image: redwood/app:1.8.3. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/backout-v1.8.3

alice: I'm the deploy owner — quick summary: app + proxy updates, no DB schema migrations. We'll run smoke tests, then ramp traffic to 100%. Oncall: @dave-oncall. Backout/runbook linked above.

carla: Thanks. Confirming: no irreversible DB steps? any long-running jobs impacted?

alice: No DB schema changes. We will drain workers for 2 minutes before cutover to avoid in-flight jobs. If something unexpected, we flip the feature flag and rollback image.

dave-oncall: I'll be on standby. What's the explicit rollback procedure so I can practice it during T-10?

alice: Rollback snippet (put in ops clipbook):
```
# rollback to previous image
kubectl set image deployment/app app=redwood/app:1.8.2 -n prod
# restart proxy to clear routing cache
kubectl rollout restart deployment/proxy -n prod
# verify pods are Ready and smoke tests pass
```

erin-sre: FYI if we unexpectedly need DB rollback later, follow runbook step 3 for logical dump/restore. Link in the runbook has the exact pg_dump/restore commands and retention note.

bob: Adding quick smoke checklist we should run after deploy:
1) GET /health -> 200
2) Auth flow sign-in + token issuance
3) POST /v1/generate sample prompt -> 1 non-empty result
4) Embeddings job end-to-end small sample
5) Check logs for obvious stacktraces

alice: Also watch metrics: 5xx rate threshold 0.5% (if above -> rollback), token-latency p95 < 400ms. If any of those fail, we rollback and open an incident.

carla: :thumbsup: I'll run the auth + embeddings checks.

incidents-bot: Reminder: if rollback is executed, create incident via /incident create and link runbook with tag backout-v1.8.3.

dave-oncall: Rollback coordination note: once we agree to backout, infra will pin capacity and flip traffic. Estimated rollback time ~10 minutes after decision. I'll post progress updates.

alice: OK proceeding. I'll start deploy at T-0. Will post 'deploy completed' and attach the smoke results. If anyone sees >0.5% 5xx or p95 regression during the ramp, call the rollback in this thread.

bob: Minor note — feature-flag for the new routing is named ff:new-routing-1.8.3 (we can toggle to disable without image change).

alice: Good — that's our fast-fail path if deploy shows behavioral issues.

dave-oncall: Ready. ttyl at T+10.

alice: (T+12) Deploy finished: all pods Ready, smoke checklist complete. 5xx=0.02%, p95=320ms. Rolling to 100%.

carla: Verified auth + embeddings. No errors observed.

incidents-bot: Deploy annotated in changelog, runbook check recorded.

alice: Closing thread — no backout needed. Runbook noted for future runs. Thanks team :party-parrot:
